in_marathi.name: Phalguni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of Spring
in_marathi.long_meaning: Phalguni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Phalguni is derived from the Sanskrit word 'phalgun' which means 'bringing forth' or 'producing'. The name is associated with the Hindu goddess Phalguni or Phalguni Devi, who symbolizes the onset of spring and new beginnings. The name is also believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
